description: Executable creative-decision contract used by model-robust generation and its quality gate.

oneBuildPreflight.goal: The first emitted implementation must satisfy every automated quality criterion; do not rely on a later visual repair pass for predictable defects.
beforeCode: name the selected quality profile, product intent, visual thesis, type jobs, focal hierarchy, rhythm argument, and closing surface
assign every repeated surface an owned foreground pair and reject normal-text pairs below 4.5:1 or large-text pairs below 3:1 before choosing decorative combinations
limit rendered typography to two primary faces plus one annotation face and no more than four perceptual 100-weight bands
reserve at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels for every rendered interactive target, including short text links where height alone is insufficient
choose the hero focal subject and expressive work-subject scale before laying out cards or frames
write desktop and mobile containment rules, final visible content states, font delivery, and reduced-motion behavior into the first implementation
use local deterministic assets, UTF-8 text, and encoded HTML symbols; do not depend on remote runtime requests
oneBuildPreflight.surfacePairRule: Any selector that changes a surface background also assigns or inherits a verified foreground role for text, icons, captions, hover, focus, and active states.
firstBuildAcceptance: no runtime errors, external requests, broken assets, mojibake, hidden meaningful content, or horizontal overflow
zero normal-text and large-text contrast failures at desktop and mobile
zero interactive targets below 44 by 44 CSS pixels
intended display font rendered, no more than three functional font families, and no more than four perceptual weight bands
reduced-motion leaves all content visible and caps essential transitions at 100ms

display.job: identity, major hierarchy, and the product's emotional register
display.selectionTest: Render the real hero and one section heading before committing; reject a face whose fallback changes the voice.

body.job: reading, explanation, actions, and repeated product communication
body.selectionTest: Must remain calm and legible at 14-18px with deliberate 45-75ch measure.

annotation.job: operational metadata, timestamps, status, labels, and numeric evidence
annotation.selectionTest: Use a mono or tabular voice only where scanning structured data benefits.

operationalProduct.displayVoice: distinctive editorial or variable grotesk with a technical but human register
operationalProduct.annotationVoice: restrained mono or tabular UI voice
avoid: condensed system fallback used as the final display voice
one undifferentiated family carrying display, body, and operational metadata
aggressive compression that damages word shape or mobile wrapping

expressiveStudio.displayVoice: identity face with enough character to own repeated display moments
expressiveStudio.bodyVoice: editorial reading voice selected for the concept
expressiveStudio.annotationVoice: UI/control voice kept out of expressive prose
compositionTests: the first viewport states a concept-specific proposition at identity scale rather than presenting the studio name alone
work subjects use authored artwork, variable scale, deliberate crop, and owned text backdrops instead of equal picture cards
poster-volume moments alternate with editorial breathing room and utility lists so the whole page does not shout at one volume
avoid: fashionable agency pairing without repeated functional roles
decorative font switching inside one semantic role
equalized project cards that suppress the focal subject, crop logic, or editorial rhythm

fontDelivery.standaloneRule: Bundle properly licensed font files or use a verified system stack; never depend on a silent fallback.

closingCta.rule: The closing CTA resolves the established palette story. Reuse the page's signal/accent or a primary surface; do not introduce a muddy near-match or a new campaign color at the final section.
closingCta.largeAccentSurfaceCondition: A full accent field is allowed only when the accent was restrained earlier and text/button contrast is verified on the rendered surface.
